story.title: Republicans Warn of Democratic Threat at Midterm Convention
story.summary: During the second night of their midterm convention in Dallas, Republican speakers emphasized the narrative that Democrats pose a significant threat to America. This event marks the first midterm convention for the party, typically reserved for presidential election cycles.

timeline_highlights.title: Kushner and Jeffries Meet Ahead of Midterm Elections
timeline_highlights.summary: Jared Kushner met with Democratic leader Hakeem Jeffries in New York City to discuss potential cooperation between Democrats and Trump as the midterm elections approach. The meeting comes as control of the House is at stake in the upcoming November elections, with Democrats expected to gain an advantage. Topics discussed included housing, immigration, and the rising cost of living.

event_overview.title: About Midterm Elections
event_overview.subject: Midterm Elections
event_overview.summary: U.S. midterm elections are the regularly scheduled federal elections held in even-numbered years when no presidential election is on the ballot, choosing members of Congress and often coinciding with state and local contests. The 2026 general election is scheduled for November 3, with all House seats and one of the Senate’s three election classes at issue.

facts.label: Date
facts.value: The next regularly scheduled federal general election is Tuesday, November 3, 2026; federal law sets House elections for the Tuesday after the first Monday in November in every even-numbered year.

facts.label: House elections
facts.value: All 435 voting seats in the U.S. House of Representatives are contested every two years; representatives serve two-year terms.

facts.label: Senate elections
facts.value: Senators serve six-year terms divided into three classes, so approximately one-third of the Senate stands for election or reelection every two years.

facts.label: Election administration
facts.value: Federal elections are administered primarily under state law, commonly by county or other local election authorities, subject to applicable federal requirements.

facts.label: Campaign-finance oversight
facts.value: The Federal Election Commission administers and enforces federal campaign-finance law for House and Senate campaigns, including disclosure rules and contribution and expenditure restrictions.

event_overview.scope_note: The selected Muninn timeline covers particular political events and campaign-related developments connected to the midterms, not every federal, state, or local race, ballot measure, administrative process, or result.

related_stories.title: Kimmel's Interview with Talarico to Air on YouTube Due to FCC Pressure
related_stories.summary: Jimmy Kimmel announced that his interview with James Talarico, the Democratic candidate for U.S. Senate in Texas, will not be broadcast on television due to perceived threats from the Federal Communications Commission (FCC). Instead, the interview will be available on YouTube, allowing it to bypass FCC regulations.

related_stories.title: Emma Bonino, influential Italian politician, passes away at 78
related_stories.summary: Emma Bonino, a prominent Italian politician known for her leadership in campaigns to legalize abortion and divorce, has died at the age of 78. She was a significant figure in the Radical Party and faced opposition from the Vatican during her advocacy in the 1970s. Her party, More Europe, expressed deep sorrow over her passing, highlighting her courage and vision in Italian politics.

related_stories.title: Zelenskyy Visits Canada for Increased Military Support Amid Russian Attacks
related_stories.summary: Ukrainian leader Volodymyr Zelenskyy is visiting Canada to request additional military support as Russia intensifies its air campaign against Ukraine. The attacks have focused on Ukraine's power grid, aiming to undermine civilian morale ahead of winter. This visit comes as Ukraine's drone operations have led to significant disruptions in Russian air travel.

related_stories.title: Anthropic Prevents AI Misuse for Weapons Development and Cyber Attacks
related_stories.summary: Anthropic has announced that it successfully blocked attempts by malicious actors to use its artificial intelligence models for activities related to cyber attacks and the development of biological weapons. The company highlighted that these efforts included attempts to create missile guidance software and conduct surveillance. This action comes amid growing concerns about the potential misuse of AI technologies.
